title: symphyotrichum × salignum
intro: Symphyotrichum × salignum, commonly known as the New England aster, is a hybrid plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of New England aster include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Symphyotrichum × salignum have been shown to possess wound-healing properties, and may also have potential in the treatment of certain cancers due to their cytotoxic effects.
